Fact.Name: Wisconsin single standard deduction maximum
Fact.Description: Maximum single standard deduction. 2025 Form 1 instructions, Standard Deduction Table.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin married filing jointly standard deduction maximum
Fact.Description: Maximum married filing jointly standard deduction. 2025 Form 1 instructions, Standard Deduction Table.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin single standard deduction phaseout start
Fact.Description: Single standard deduction phaseout starts when the band midpoint passes this amount. The amount reproduces the table. It is not printed as its own line.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin married filing jointly standard deduction phaseout start
Fact.Description: Married filing jointly standard deduction phaseout starts when the band midpoint passes this amount. The amount reproduces the table. It is not printed as its own line.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin single standard deduction phaseout rate
Fact.Description: Single standard deduction phaseout rate. 12 percent of the amount by which the band midpoint exceeds the phaseout start. The rate reproduces the table.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin married filing jointly standard deduction phaseout rate
Fact.Description: Married filing jointly standard deduction phaseout rate, 19.778 percent. The rate reproduces the table.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin standard deduction first row top
Fact.Description: Top of the first standard deduction row. At least $0 but less than this amount.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin standard deduction second row top
Fact.Description: Top of the second standard deduction row and the start of the $500 rows.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin standard deduction row width
Fact.Description: Width of a standard deduction row after the second row.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin last standard deduction row start
Fact.Description: Start of the last married filing jointly standard deduction row, at least this amount but less than $155,169.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin standard deduction zero threshold
Fact.Description: Wisconsin income of this amount or more has a standard deduction of zero.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin personal exemption
Fact.Description: Exemption amount for the filer, and for the spouse on a joint return. Line 10b uses $250 and is out of scope.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin tax table ceiling
Fact.Description: Taxable income below this amount uses the tax table. This amount or more uses the worksheet.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin tax table first row top
Fact.Description: Top of the first tax table row. At least $0 but less than this amount.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin tax table second row top
Fact.Description: Top of the second tax table row.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin tax table third row top
Fact.Description: Top of the third tax table row. Later rows are this wide.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin 3.5 percent rate
Fact.Description: First bracket rate, 3.5 percent. Wis. Stat. section 71.06. The rate reproduces the tax table.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin 4.4 percent rate
Fact.Description: Second bracket rate, 4.4 percent. Wis. Stat. section 71.06. The rate reproduces the tax table.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin 5.3 percent rate
Fact.Description: Third bracket rate, 5.3 percent. 2025 Form 1 instructions, page 44 worksheet.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin 7.65 percent rate
Fact.Description: Top bracket rate, 7.65 percent. 2025 Form 1 instructions, page 44 worksheet.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin single 3.5 percent bracket top
Fact.Description: Top of the single 3.5 percent bracket. Derived so the worksheet matches the tax table.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin single 4.4 percent bracket top
Fact.Description: Top of the single 4.4 percent bracket. Derived so the worksheet matches the tax table.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin single 7.65 percent threshold
Fact.Description: Single taxable income of this amount or more uses 7.65 percent on the worksheet. Less than this amount, and at least $100,000, uses 5.3 percent.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin joint 3.5 percent bracket top
Fact.Description: Top of the married filing jointly 3.5 percent bracket. Derived so the worksheet matches the tax table.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin joint 4.4 percent bracket top
Fact.Description: Top of the married filing jointly 4.4 percent bracket. Derived so the worksheet matches the tax table.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin joint 7.65 percent threshold
Fact.Description: Married filing jointly taxable income of this amount or more uses 7.65 percent on the worksheet.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin single tax at the 3.5 percent bracket top
Fact.Description: Single tax at the top of the 3.5 percent bracket. 3.5 percent of $14,680.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin single tax at the 4.4 percent bracket top
Fact.Description: Single tax at the top of the 4.4 percent bracket.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin joint tax at the 3.5 percent bracket top
Fact.Description: Married filing jointly tax at the top of the 3.5 percent bracket. 3.5 percent of $19,580.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin joint tax at the 4.4 percent bracket top
Fact.Description: Married filing jointly tax at the top of the 4.4 percent bracket.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin single worksheet subtraction at 5.3 percent
Fact.Description: Single worksheet subtraction for taxable income of at least $100,000 but less than $323,290.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin single worksheet subtraction at 7.65 percent
Fact.Description: Single worksheet subtraction for taxable income of $323,290 or more.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin joint worksheet subtraction at 5.3 percent
Fact.Description: Married filing jointly worksheet subtraction for taxable income of at least $100,000 but less than $431,060.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin joint worksheet subtraction at 7.65 percent
Fact.Description: Married filing jointly worksheet subtraction for taxable income of $431,060 or more.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin married couple credit rate
Fact.Description: Married couple credit rate, 3 percent. 2025 Form 1, Schedule 2, line 7.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin married couple credit wage cap
Fact.Description: Married couple credit wage cap. The credit uses the lower earner's wages, but not more than this amount, so the credit is at most $480.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin underpayment interest floor
Fact.Description: Underpayment interest applies when line 43 is at least this amount and more than 10 percent of line 22. Schedule U is not built.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin underpayment interest share of tax
Fact.Description: Underpayment interest applies when line 43 is more than this share of line 22. Lines 30 through 35 are zero in scope, so the tax shown is line 22.

Fact.Name: Zero
Fact.Description: Zero entered on Form 1 lines this return does not use.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin residency answers
Fact.Description: Full-year resident is the supported Form 1. Part-year and nonresident returns use Form 1NPR and stop.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin residency
Fact.Description: Full year means you, and your spouse if you file jointly, were Wisconsin residents all year. Part-year and nonresident stop.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin additions or subtractions
Fact.Description: Yes if the return has a Schedule AD or Schedule SB amount, including medical or long-term care insurance, tuition, private-school tuition, Edvest, Tomorrow's Scholar, ABLE, armed forces active-duty pay, or any other Wisconsin addition or subtraction.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin credits this tool does not calculate
Fact.Description: Yes if the return claims the school property tax credit, the itemized deduction credit, the homestead credit, the veterans property tax credit, or a Schedule CR credit.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin use tax
Fact.Description: Yes if sales or use tax is due on out-of-state purchases. Line 23 is not calculated.

Fact.Name: Income tax paid to another state
Fact.Description: Yes if Wisconsin income was also taxed by another state. Line 20 is not calculated.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 1 federal adjusted gross income
Fact.Description: Federal AGI, Form 1040 line 11. 2025 Form 1, line 1.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 2
Fact.Description: Zero. Schedule I adjustments stop the return. 2025 Form 1, line 2.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 4
Fact.Description: Zero. Schedule AD additions stop the return. 2025 Form 1, line 4.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 6
Fact.Description: Zero. Schedule SB subtractions stop the return. 2025 Form 1, line 6.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 3
Fact.Description: Line 1 plus line 2. Line 2 is zero, so this equals line 1. 2025 Form 1, line 3.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 5
Fact.Description: Line 3 plus line 4. Line 4 is zero, so this equals line 1. 2025 Form 1, line 5.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 7 Wisconsin income
Fact.Description: Line 5 minus line 6. Line 6 is zero, so this equals line 1. The standard deduction is keyed on this line. 2025 Form 1, line 7.

Fact.Name: W-2 wages included in line 3
Fact.Description: Federal W-2 wages. On a supported return that is the only income in line 3.

Fact.Name: Standard deduction row midpoint
Fact.Description: At least / but less than. Below $13,390 the midpoint is half of that edge. From $13,390 to $13,500 it is the average of the edges. A $500 row uses its start plus $250. From $155,000 to $155,169 it is the average of those edges. $155,169 or more does not use a midpoint.

Fact.Name: Standard deduction maximum for this filing status
Fact.Description: Married filing jointly uses the joint maximum. Every other status uses the single maximum. A status other than single or joint stops.

Fact.Name: Standard deduction phaseout start for this filing status
Fact.Description: Married filing jointly uses the joint start. Every other status uses the single start.

Fact.Name: Standard deduction phaseout rate for this filing status
Fact.Description: Married filing jointly uses 19.778 percent. Every other status uses 12 percent.

Fact.Name: Band midpoint minus the phaseout start
Fact.Description: Negative while the deduction is still at the maximum.

Fact.Name: Standard deduction before the floor and the cap
Fact.Description: Maximum minus the phaseout rate times the excess.

Fact.Name: Standard deduction after the floor and the cap, before the dollar round
Fact.Description: Not below zero and not above the maximum.

Fact.Name: One hundred times the exact capped standard deduction
Fact.Description: One hundred times the maximum, minus the excess times one hundred times the rate, then clamped to zero and to one hundred times the maximum. For these rates the product is exact to a tenth of a cent.

Fact.Name: Standard deduction after the cent-then-dollar round
Fact.Description: Round of the capped amount. Dollar times Rational scales to cents half-even before Round half-up.

Fact.Name: Standard deduction rounded once
Fact.Description: One half-up round. Subtract $1 when the cent-then-dollar result exceeds the exact product by more than 50 cents. An exact half dollar stays the half-up dollar.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 8 standard deduction
Fact.Description: The rounded table amount. Wisconsin income of $155,169 or more is zero. 2025 Form 1, line 8.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 9
Fact.Description: Line 7 minus line 8, not below zero. 2025 Form 1, line 9.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 10a exemption count
Fact.Description: One for the filer. Two on a joint return. No dependent exemptions.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 10a exemption amount
Fact.Description: The exemption count times $700. 2025 Form 1, line 10a.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 10b box count
Fact.Description: Zero. Age 65 or blindness stops the return. 2025 Form 1, line 10b.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 10b amount
Fact.Description: Zero. The $250 additional exemption is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 10b.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 10c
Fact.Description: Line 10a plus line 10b. Line 10b is zero, so this equals line 10a. 2025 Form 1, line 10c.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 11
Fact.Description: Line 9 minus line 10c, not below zero. 2025 Form 1, line 11.

Fact.Name: Line 11 uses the tax table
Fact.Description: True when line 11 is less than $100,000. $100,000 or more uses the worksheet. A row is at least the low amount and less than the high amount.

Fact.Name: Tax table row midpoint
Fact.Description: At least / but less than. Below $20 the midpoint is $10. Below $40 it is $30. Below $100 it is $70. A later row is the $100 boundary plus $50. Line 11 of $100,000 does not use this midpoint.

Fact.Name: Tax at the bottom of the table bracket
Fact.Description: Zero in the 3.5 percent bracket. The bracket base in a later bracket. Married filing jointly uses the joint schedule. Any other status uses the single schedule.

Fact.Name: Midpoint minus the table bracket floor
Fact.Description: The midpoint itself in the 3.5 percent bracket.

Fact.Name: Table bracket rate
Fact.Description: 3.5, 4.4, or 5.3 percent. The table stops below $100,000, under the 7.65 percent threshold.

Fact.Name: Table tax after the cent-then-dollar round
Fact.Description: Round of the base plus the excess times the rate.

Fact.Name: One hundred times the exact table tax
Fact.Description: One hundred times the base, plus the excess times one hundred times the rate.

Fact.Name: Tax table amount rounded once
Fact.Description: One half-up round of the tax at the row midpoint. Subtract $1 when the cent-then-dollar result exceeds the exact product by more than 50 cents.

Fact.Name: Worksheet rate
Fact.Description: 5.3 percent below the top threshold and 7.65 percent at or above it. Married filing jointly uses the joint threshold.

Fact.Name: Worksheet subtraction
Fact.Description: The page 44 subtraction for this filing status and this line 11.

Fact.Name: Worksheet tax before the dollar round
Fact.Description: Line 11 times the rate, minus the subtraction.

Fact.Name: Worksheet tax after the cent-then-dollar round
Fact.Description: Round of line 11 times the rate minus the subtraction.

Fact.Name: One hundred times the exact worksheet tax
Fact.Description: Line 11 times one hundred times the rate, minus one hundred times the subtraction.

Fact.Name: Worksheet tax rounded once
Fact.Description: One half-up round of the page 44 worksheet. Subtract $1 when the cent-then-dollar result exceeds the exact product by more than 50 cents.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 12 tax
Fact.Description: The tax table amount when line 11 is less than $100,000. The worksheet amount when line 11 is $100,000 or more. 2025 Form 1, line 12.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 13
Fact.Description: Zero. The itemized deduction credit stops the return. 2025 Form 1, line 13.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 14
Fact.Description: Zero. The additional child and dependent care credit stops the return. 2025 Form 1, line 14.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 15
Fact.Description: Zero. The blind worker transportation services credit stops the return. 2025 Form 1, line 15.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 16
Fact.Description: Zero. The school property tax credit stops the return. 2025 Form 1, line 16.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 19
Fact.Description: Zero. The Schedule CR nonrefundable credits stops the return. 2025 Form 1, line 19.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 20
Fact.Description: Zero. The tax paid to another state stops the return. 2025 Form 1, line 20.

Fact.Name: Your wages for Schedule 2
Fact.Description: Primary filer W-2 wages, column A.

Fact.Name: Spouse wages for Schedule 2
Fact.Description: Secondary filer W-2 wages on a joint return. Zero otherwise.

Fact.Name: Schedule 2 line 6
Fact.Description: The smaller of the two spouses' wages, but not more than $16,000. Zero when the return is not joint.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 18 married couple credit
Fact.Description: 3 percent of Schedule 2 line 6, rounded half up to the dollar. 3 percent of a whole-dollar amount is exact to the cent. The wage cap makes the credit at most $480. Zero when the return is not joint. 2025 Form 1, line 18.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 21
Fact.Description: The sum of lines 13 through 20. Every credit except line 18 is zero, so this equals line 18. 2025 Form 1, line 21.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 22 net tax
Fact.Description: Line 12 minus line 21, not below zero. The form body subtracts line 21. 2025 Form 1, line 22.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 23
Fact.Description: Zero. sales and use tax is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 23.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 24
Fact.Description: Zero. donations is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 24.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 25
Fact.Description: Zero. penalties on retirement plans is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 25.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 26
Fact.Description: Zero. other penalties is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 26.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 27
Fact.Description: The sum of lines 22 through 26. Lines 23 through 26 are zero, so this equals line 22. 2025 Form 1, line 27.

Fact.Name: This W-2's Wisconsin withholding
Fact.Description: Box 17 when box 15 is Wisconsin, the same state as the residence. A blank box 15 is in scope and contributes zero. A box 15 for another state stops the return and contributes zero here.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 28 Wisconsin tax withheld
Fact.Description: Sum of W-2 box 17 where box 15 is Wisconsin. 2025 Form 1, line 28.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 29
Fact.Description: Zero. estimated tax payments is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 29.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 30
Fact.Description: Zero. earned income credit is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 30.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 31
Fact.Description: Zero. farmland preservation credit is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 31.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 32
Fact.Description: Zero. repayment credit is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 32.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 33
Fact.Description: Zero. homestead credit is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 33.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 34
Fact.Description: Zero. veterans property tax credit is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 34.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 35
Fact.Description: Zero. refundable Schedule CR credits is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 35.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 36
Fact.Description: Zero. amounts previously paid is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 36.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 38
Fact.Description: Zero. amounts previously refunded is not calculated. 2025 Form 1, line 38.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 37
Fact.Description: The sum of lines 28 through 36. Every line except line 28 is zero, so this equals line 28. 2025 Form 1, line 37.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 39
Fact.Description: Line 37 minus line 38. Line 38 is zero, so this equals line 28. 2025 Form 1, line 39.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 40 overpayment
Fact.Description: Line 39 minus line 27, not below zero. 2025 Form 1, line 40.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 41 refund
Fact.Description: The overpayment. Nothing is applied to next year's estimated tax. 2025 Form 1, line 41.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 42 applied to estimated tax
Fact.Description: Zero. 2025 Form 1, line 42.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 43 amount underpaid
Fact.Description: Line 27 minus line 39, not below zero. 2025 Form 1, line 43.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 44 underpayment interest
Fact.Description: Zero. The return stops when underpayment interest is due, so a printed return has no interest. 2025 Form 1, line 44.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 45 amount you owe
Fact.Description: Line 43 plus line 44. Line 44 is zero, so this equals line 43. 2025 Form 1, line 45.

Fact.Name: Form 1 line 46 interest
Fact.Description: Zero. 2025 Form 1, line 46.

Fact.Name: Federal income other than W-2 wages
Fact.Description: Interest, tax-exempt interest, Social Security, a sale or capital gain, 1099-MISC, a 1099-R, Schedule C, or Schedule E. Any of that income stops a Form 1.

Fact.Name: Dependents or a qualifying person
Fact.Description: Anyone in the household, or a filer who is a qualifying person for the child and dependent care credit. The extra exemption, the Wisconsin earned income credit, and Wisconsin Form 2441 are not calculated.

Fact.Name: Age 65 or blind
Fact.Description: Primary filer is 65 or older or blind. On a joint return, either spouse. Line 10b and the federal additional standard deduction are not calculated. The spouse is checked only on a joint return.

Fact.Name: Filer can be claimed as a dependent
Fact.Description: The primary filer, or either spouse on a joint return. Someone who can be claimed does not use the standard deduction table. The spouse is checked only on a joint return.

Fact.Name: Filing status other than single or joint
Fact.Description: The supported Form 1 is single, or married filing jointly with both spouses Wisconsin residents all year. Married filing separately and head of household are not calculated.

Fact.Name: Wisconsin residency is part-year or nonresident
Fact.Description: True for Form 1NPR. Incomplete until residency is answered.

Fact.Name: Underpayment interest is due
Fact.Description: Line 43 is at least $500 and more than 10 percent of line 22. Lines 30 through 35 are zero, so the tax shown is line 22. Schedule U is not built. Prior-year exceptions are not applied.

Fact.Name: Joint return with deferred compensation this tool does not split
Fact.Description: Married filing jointly, and a W-2 box 11 amount or a box 12 code H amount. Federal Schedule 1 lines 12, 16, 20, 24e, and 24g are not separate facts and cannot be nonzero here. The Wisconsin disability income exclusion is asked with the additions question. Box 11 also stops every return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: part-year or nonresident
Fact.Description: Form 1NPR is not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return. 2025 Form 1 instructions, filing requirements.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: a W-2 box 15 is not Wisconsin
Fact.Description: Any W-2 whose box 15 is a state other than Wisconsin. A blank box 15 is in scope and is not this stop. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: income other than W-2 wages
Fact.Description: Any federal income other than W-2 wages. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: dependents
Fact.Description: A dependent exemption, the Wisconsin earned income credit, or Wisconsin Form 2441. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: age 65 or blind
Fact.Description: Line 10b and the federal additional standard deduction are not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: filer can be claimed as a dependent
Fact.Description: The standard deduction table is not used when the filer or spouse can be claimed. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return. 2025 Form 1 instructions, line 8.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: filing status
Fact.Description: Married filing separately and head of household are not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: itemized deductions
Fact.Description: Federal Schedule A. The itemized deduction credit is not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: federal Schedule 1-A
Fact.Description: Schedule 1-A line 44 is greater than zero. Wisconsin conformity for that deduction is not pinned. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Wisconsin additions or subtractions
Fact.Description: Schedule AD, Schedule SB, or Schedule I. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: credits this tool does not calculate
Fact.Description: School property tax credit, itemized deduction credit, homestead credit, veterans property tax credit, or Schedule CR. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: use tax
Fact.Description: Line 23 is not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return. 2025 Form 1, line 23.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: tax paid to another state
Fact.Description: Line 20 is not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: underpayment interest
Fact.Description: Line 43 is at least $500 and more than 10 percent of line 22. Schedule U is not built. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return. 2025 Form 1 instructions, page 33.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: joint deferred compensation
Fact.Description: A joint return with W-2 box 11 or box 12 code H. Schedule 2 line 4 is not calculated. Complete false when this is not a Wisconsin return. 2025 Form 1, Schedule 2, line 4.
